name: zoom-zepa
title: Zoom Zepa
description: Catalog loupe — three rivers of tags scroll past each other, and a glass sits on top. Drag it (or nudge it with the arrow keys) and the chips under the aperture sharpen, pick up colour, and enlarge around the point you are looking at. The rivers are CSS; the lens writes its position to custom properties, so a drag never re-renders.
